info.name: Cyberpunk x Volcano
info.description: A sleek, high-contrast Cyberpunk interface featuring blood red sky and volcano backgrounds and glowing neon accents.
info.additionalInfo:
The Cyberpunk  x Volcano theme replaces the flat, corporate look of YouTube with a vibrant, synthwave-inspired aesthetic.
